content.quote: Technology without strategy is overhead. Our goal is to transform code into a dominant business advantage for every client we serve.

content.heading: Frequently Asked Questions About Partnering With Us

faqs.q: What engagement models do you support?
faqs.a: We offer dedicated team augmentation, milestone-based fixed price projects, and time-and-materials agile sprints depending on your product stage and requirements.

faqs.q: How do you handle Intellectual Property (IP) and NDAs?
faqs.a: Full 100% IP ownership transfers to you upon final invoice settlement. We execute strict bilateral NDAs prior to any technical briefing or architectural review.

faqs.q: Can you scale a team on short notice?
faqs.a: Yes, our bench of pre-vetted engineers allows us to onboard senior React, Flutter, Node.js, and Python developers within 3-7 business days.

faqs.q: Do you offer post-launch maintenance & SLA support?
faqs.a: We provide 24/7 dedicated monitoring, zero-downtime updates, infrastructure patching, and continuous feature roadmapping via customized SLA tiers.
